name: delivery-app support bot
about: 12 small tasks a food-delivery app's support bot must get right. Each task has one prompt and one or more automatic checks; a task passes only if every check passes. Edit freely: add tasks from your own app.
system: You are the support assistant for a food-delivery app in Riyadh. Follow the output format exactly. No extra words.

tasks.prompt:
Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: late_delivery, wrong_item, payment, account, other.
Ticket: "My order arrived cold and 40 minutes late."
Answer with the label only.

Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: late_delivery, wrong_item, payment, account, other.
Ticket: "I was charged twice for order #5521."
Answer with the label only.

Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: late_delivery, wrong_item, payment, account, other.
Ticket: "The app says my password is wrong but I reset it five minutes ago."
Answer with the label only.

Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: late_delivery, wrong_item, payment, account, other.
Ticket: "I ordered a chicken shawarma and got a falafel wrap."
Answer with the label only.

Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: late_delivery, wrong_item, payment, account, other.
Ticket: "انخصم المبلغ من بطاقتي مرتين على نفس الطلب"
Answer with the label only.

Extract the customer's name, order id and phone number from this message as JSON with keys name, order_id, phone (all strings).
Message: "Hi, it's Sara. Order 88213 is missing the drinks. Call me on 0551234567."
Return only the JSON object.

Extract the order id and the item the customer wants refunded as JSON with keys order_id (string) and item (string, lowercase).
Message: "Order 40177: the kunafa was squashed, please refund it, the rest was fine."
Return only the JSON object.
The food costs 54 SAR and delivery costs 9 SAR. A 20% discount applies to the food only. What is the total the customer pays, in SAR? Answer with the number only.
A customer paid 120 SAR for 4 identical items. One item was missing. How much should we refund, in SAR? Answer with the number only.
A driver completes one delivery every 20 minutes and works a 7.5-hour shift with a 30-minute unpaid break. How many deliveries can they complete? Answer with the number only.
Write a one-sentence apology to a customer whose order was 40 minutes late. At most 25 words. No emojis.
Reply to the customer in Arabic only, in one short sentence, telling them their refund will arrive within 3 days.
